title: English Variant key for A/B reporting
changes: Use exactly Variant=A or Variant=B for public GPT targeting and measurement diagnostics.
Retain 3.14.0 cache, auction, consent and Prebid behavior; existing versions and saved packages keep their original keys and bytes.
Prepare GAM values and report templates use the exact key of the selected runtime. Both experiment arms must use the same format.

title: Simple public A/B variant labels
changes: Send only Varijant=A or Varijant=B on owned GPT slots with a valid active experiment context; keep full experiment and package identity in local diagnostics.
Retain the reviewed cache, auction, consent and Prebid behavior from 3.13.0 in a separate immutable version.
Existing versions and saved packages remain unchanged. GAM report comparisons require matching inventory and test dates because A/B labels are reused.

title: Consent-aware bid cache and final-request targeting
changes: Add explicit fresh-only and new-auction-plus-cache modes in a separately pinned runtime; enforce exact reviewed Prebid 11.34.0 artifact bytes.
Defer native targeting until owned-slot GAM submission, including both lazy paths and TakeOver; enforce TTL, size, consent-context, duplicate and late-auction guards.
Observe TCF, viewport and page lifecycle changes without overriding consent; unknown or unsupported privacy contexts cannot reuse cached offers.
Expose bounded cache selection and failure diagnostics; preserve existing runtime source closures, archived packages and catalog defaults. Candidate only, not live activation.

title: Owned-slot GAM experiment measurement
changes: Attach one delivery/variant reporting value to runtime-owned GPT slots before requests, including TakeOver.
Require a matching active loader context; preserve page-local assignment and existing bid targeting.
Retain bounded local runtime diagnostics and add measurement snapshots; no user identifiers, telemetry or CMP changes.
Candidate only, not yet selectable in the private catalog; existing versions and publisher routes remain unchanged.

title: Local runtime diagnostics and GPT lifecycle observation
changes: Count new runtime entry attempts and blocked duplicate executions without changing archived engines.
Observe owned GPT slots: requests, filled/empty render responses, iframe load and viewability events with bounded local diagnostics.
Record ambiguous overlapping requests without assigning misleading latency; no telemetry, consent or GAM targeting changes.
Experimental candidate only; not automatically selectable or activated for publishers.

title: TakeOver in Ad positions and saved lazy rules
changes: Configure TakeOver as an ad position with a responsive size map, closing timers and a per-tab display interval.
Choose GAM only or the site Prebid bidders; ad-unit and device bidder overrides apply to TakeOver.
Saved lazy fetch/render rules work in the built-in generator.
The previous 3.9.1 generator remains bundled and selectable for compatible settings; saved packages retain their original files.

title: Prebid configuration support
changes: Currency conversion follows the option selected for the site.
Prebid file checks identify missing modules and the bidder or feature requiring them.
The built-in generator continues to produce ads.js, ads.min.js and CSS from the saved site settings.

title: Built-in generator and complete test package
changes: Generate the wrapper directly in Tessera without uploading an ads.js template.
Package readable and minified JavaScript, CSS, configuration, manifest and installation instructions together.
Retain the reference 3.9.1 TakeOver behavior and verify the original Prebid file when enabled.
